name: swahili-health-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya county health indicators: maternal care, immunization and child stunting from the Kenya DHS 2022

tools.name: list_health_indicators
tools.description:
List every health indicator this server holds (id, label, population it is measured on, whether higher or lower is better) and the survey it comes from.

Call this first. All indicators are percentages from the Kenya DHS 2022 with a value for each of the 47 counties. Returns {survey, source, data_retrieved, indicators:[{id,label,population,group,direction}]}.

tools.name: get_county_health_profile
tools.description: Get every held indicator (maternal care, child immunization, child stunting) for one Kenyan county.

tools.name: get_maternal_health_indicators
tools.description: Get a county's maternal health indicators: antenatal visits (4+), antenatal care from a skilled provider, skilled assistance at delivery, health-facility delivery, and mothers with no postnatal checkup.

tools.name: get_immunization_coverage
tools.description: Get the percentage of children aged 12-23 months in a county who received a vaccine.

tools.name: compare_counties
tools.description: Rank Kenyan counties on one indicator, to see where need is greatest or coverage is best.

relatedServers.name: mpesa-mcp
relatedServers.description: M-PESA Daraja API MCP server by same author

envVars.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Google Gemini API key for AI-enhanced responses (optional — server works without it)
